text:
Mia Chen: Quick design check—updated figma for the Compliance > Encryption card. Main asks: tighten label copy for KMS toggle, increase contrast on badge, clarify audit log link.

Calvin Ortiz: LGTM overall. Can you paste the exact strings? Hard to review from figma alone.

Mia Chen: Sure: 
- Toggle label: "Customer-managed keys (KMS)"
- Helper text: "Use your KMS to control key access. Click Manage to configure." 
- Badge: small pill with "Encrypted"/"Unencrypted"

Jess Patel: Minor: the helper text feels like it promises a 'Manage' button but that's not in card. Either add the button or change to "Manage in Key settings." :thinking:

Samir Rao: Accessibility nit: current pill uses #5C9AEF on white — contrast ratio ~2.8:1. Need >=4.5:1 for normal text. If it's decorative maybe ok, but it's readable text now.

Aisha Khan: For focus states on the toggle keyboard users lose tab order—tab lands on the card header not the toggle. Should be toggle first. Also add visible focus ring (2px solid #0066CC).

Mia Chen: Good catches. Proposal: change badge color to #1D4ED8, helper text -> "Manage keys in Key settings" and reorder DOM so toggle is before header actions.

Calvin Ortiz: +1. Also audit log link copy: currently "View audit" — suggest "Open audit log" to be explicit about destination. 

copy-bot: Suggested microcopy variants:
- "Customer-managed keys (KMS) — Use your own encryption keys. Manage in Key settings."
- "Audit log — shows key usage and changes in the last 90 days."

Jess Patel: Love the first. For the audit blurb, can we avoid hardcoding 90 days unless that's enforced? Maybe "recent key activity".

Samir Rao: Quick accessibility check: buttons must have aria-pressed on toggle and aria-label that matches the visible label. Also ensure the badge uses role="status" so screenreader sees encryption state changes.

Mia Chen: I'll update the figma and push a new frame. Plan: 1) swap label, 2) bump badge color, 3) update helper copy to "Manage in Key settings", 4) add focus styles, 5) change audit copy to "Open audit log (recent key activity)". I'll tag y'all when done. :sparkles:

Calvin Ortiz: Thanks — can we also include a tiny Beta badge with tooltip "Private preview"? If added, ensure it's not primary color so it doesn't look like status.

Aisha Khan: If we add beta, use outline style and keyboard focusable. Also add accessible description.

Mia Chen: noted. Will iterate and post new frame by EOD.

Samir Rao: :thumbsup:
